title: Connect local call bot to Mente source of truth
objective: Root-owned API integration with independent read-only review: fetch actual patient, consented memories and schedules from Mente, deliver call results idempotently, configure and verify the two local services without placing real calls.
acceptance_criteria: Mente API is authoritative for patient and memory context
Integrated triggers cannot supply an arbitrary phone number
Final session payload is durably retryable and idempotent
Local services use distinct ports and server-only credentials
Synthetic cross-service roundtrip and regressions pass

result.summary: BOSS ACCEPT for local no-dial integration. Authoritative Mente API context/schedules, durable immutable result delivery, signed patient-bound callbacks, optional disabled scheduler, local install/config/start completed. Independent review APPROVE. 107 bot and 28 backend tests pass, disposable two-service HTTP smoke PASS. Running bot reports connected on port 8001 with zero active schedules. Actual telephony awaits owner Twilio/HTTPS/schedule configuration; no real domain writes, calls, commits/pushes/deployment.
